description: Source code for FXOS8700 sensor driver trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt callbacks, trigger setup, and initialization functions.

methods.name: fxos8700_gpio_callback
methods.description: Handles GPIO interrupt callback, disables further interrupts, and signals thread or work queue.

methods.name: fxos8700_handle_drdy_int
methods.description: Handles data ready interrupt, calls registered handler.

methods.name: fxos8700_handle_pulse_int
methods.description: Handles pulse (tap) interrupt, reads source register, calls handler.

methods.name: fxos8700_handle_motion_int
methods.description: Handles motion interrupt, reads source register, calls handler.

methods.name: fxos8700_handle_m_vecm_int
methods.description: Handles magnetometer vector magnitude interrupt, calls handler.

methods.name: fxos8700_handle_int
methods.description: Main interrupt handler, reads interrupt source and dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: fxos8700_thread_main
methods.description: Thread main loop for handling triggers if configured with own thread.

methods.name: fxos8700_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for global thread configuration.

methods.name: fxos8700_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures sensor triggers and interrupt routing.

methods.name: fxos8700_m_vecm_init
methods.description: Initializes magnetic vector magnitude detection registers.

methods.name: fxos8700_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes trigger handling, GPIO, and interrupt routing.
